description: Rewrite the Product initialization and Product change-standardization Claude Skills and portable Prompts as paired English canonical instructions. They must read document_language and write durable Product knowledge in that language while conversing in the user's current language.
acceptance_criteria: Product initialization and change-standardization workflows use natural English canonical instructions
Both native Skills and portable Prompts read document_language before producing durable content
Chinese and English trigger examples remain discoverable without duplicating workflow bodies
Native and portable variants preserve equivalent questions routing boundaries and outputs
